stemMd:
The researchers examined samples from the upper valley, where rainfall is frequent ______ the middle valley, where conditions vary; and the lower valley, where drought is common.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The three list items each contain an internal comma. Semicolons separate those complex items consistently, matching the semicolon already present before and the lower valley.

distractorRationale.a: The conjunction followed immediately by this punctuation does not form a grammatical boundary for the explanatory list.
distractorRationale.d: A colon would incorrectly place the rest of the list under the first item.
distractorRationale.c: The remaining list fragments would not form a complete sentence.
